nom: Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Collagen Tightening Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation, stinging, or discomfort, describing the patches as gentle and hydrating.
segments.mature: Reports on mature skin are mixed: one reviewer calls the patches especially effective on mature skin and another saw a firming effect on a 70-year-old's under-eyes, but two reviewers in their 40s, including one in perimenopause, saw little to no change on their own skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report a visible tightening, firming, or softening of fine lines and crow's feet within minutes to a few uses, though several say they saw no visible difference in puffiness or smoothness even after repeated use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the patches as leaving the under-eye area more hydrated and plumped, including immediately after a single use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, consistently report no irritation, stinging, or redness from the patches.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in the look of dark circles and brighter under-eyes, including one who had struggled with dark circles for years.

aspects.libelle: Opaque-to-clear color change signals when to remove
Takes one to two hours to fully absorb
Pricey for the number of patches included

extraits.titre: I would not buy this product again
extraits.texte: Did not see any difference in my under eye puffiness. I used as directed and was really hoping for better results.
I've tried them twice and kept them out for over 2 hours and they never changed from opaque to clear. They have been completely ineffective. Very disappointing considering the cost.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't think I have mature enough skin to see a difference, the skin did feel a little tighter for about an hour in that area after using it, but didn't see a visible difference. I think would recommend it for those with looser skin around the eyes.

I bought these before going to a wedding where I had to put makeup on a 70 year old and I was worried about her under eye area. I also used them myself since I was pretty tired. On her, it wasn't a drastic difference but I could tell that these temporarily firmed her under eyes and made makeup application easier. On my own eyes (I'm mid 40s) it didn't do that much for me but it also didn't hurt. For the money I don't think I'd repurchase.

These eyes patches are like a mini spa for your eyes! After just one use, I noticed a visible tightening effect, and my under eye area felt smooth and refreshed. The patches stay in place without sliding, and the cooling sensation is very soothing. I have sensitive skin, and these didn't irritate my eye area at all. These were especially perfect for those early mornings when I need a little pick me up, they give brightness and lift.

extraits.titre: I was skeptical but I really love these
extraits.texte: These patches truly do work. I am 46, and in the throws of perimenopause. IKYK. This stage of life reeks havoc on all aspects of your body. Skin being on of the biggest issues. My eyes began looking tired, more wrinkles, and always had bags. I looked these up online a decided why not give them a try. I'm so glad I did. Along with good eye care and consistency these do help make your eyes look less tired and more youthful. Its not like getting a lower blepharoplasty, but definitely helps those of us who can't afford one!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am someone who struggles with dark under eyes and with this product I have seen such a big differences. This is so easy to use and comes well packaged with a small brush that I use to apply the product. I had no irritation after this product and didn't feel any stinging. The texture is very silky.
